traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Table 7 (pages 6-7, PDF pp.22-23) contains multiple sub-protocol variants per category (e.g. different enrichment/extraction protocols, incubation times, DNA clean-up options). For each category I selected the first/primary protocol variant's 'Total' row as the canonical result: Category 1 (protocol A, Bax Lysis without DNA clean-up); Category 2 Raw beef meat - used protocol C 10h (first listed) rather than the C 24h variant, which gave slightly different SE ref (87.1 vs 84.4) and FNR values; Category 3 Milk/dairy - used 'Bax Lysis without DNA clean-up' totals (identical Total row repeated for the DNA clean-up variant in the source table, likely a copy-paste artifact in the original report - both show 84.4/82.2/83.0); Category 7 Environmental samples - used protocol A (Bax Lysis without DNA clean-up) rather than protocol I variants (with/without DNA clean-up) which had different values (96.7/100.0/100.0 and 100/100/100); Category 10 Pet food/ingredients - used protocol G1 Bax Lysis without DNA clean-up (100/100/100) rather than G1 with DNA clean-up (96.9/100/98.4) or G2 variants (85.7/91.4/87.1); Category 11 Cocoa/chocolates - used protocol H1 Bax Lysis without DNA clean-up (74.2/83.9/78.7) rather than H1 with clean-up (identical) or H2 variants (100/100/100). Alternate protocol variants and their differing performance are noted here per instructions rather than included as separate category entries. Summary/aggregate rows ('All protocols - short/long incubation time...') were excluded as instructed. No numeric Acceptability Limit for qualitative comparison was explicitly stated in the visible text (AL is referenced qualitatively, e.g. 'observed values ≤ AL' for TND/PD in section 3.3, but no single log-based AL applies since this is a qualitative/detection method).
